title: INSTALLATION OF REAR SHOCK ABSORBER
ocr_text:
REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Rear Suspension
(Coil Spring and Shock Absorber)

RA-59

INSTALLATION OF REAR SHOCK ABSORBER

1. INSTALL BUMPER, COIL SPRING AND SUSPENSION SUPPORT
(a) Mount the shock absorber in a vise.
(b) Using SST, compress the coil spring.
SST 09727-30020

SST

RA1391

(c) Install the bumper to the shock absorber.
(d) Align the coil spring end with the lower seat hollow and install the coil spring.

RA2800

(e) Align the suspension support hole and piston rod and install it.

RA2081

Shock Absorber Bushing
Piston Rod
Suspension Support

RA2612

(f) Align the suspension support with the shock absorber lower bushing as shown.

(g) Install the suspension support nut.
Torque: 280 kg-cm (20 ft-lb, 27 N-m)

RA1393
